comparison_population: same nominal role within the frozen TI 2026 109-map corpus
official_metric_source: Only metric definitions with official_score_eligible=true and passed V1/V2 publication gates.
experimental_metric_source: Only metric definitions with experimental_score_eligible=true and passed V3 evidence/calibration gates; counterfactual values remain explicitly experimental.
missing_metric_policy: Suppress an axis when a required applicable metric is unavailable. Never impute 0 or 50.
optional_axis_policy: A role may declare an optional axis. If it is unavailable, disclose the omission and renormalize only the remaining role axis weights for that displayed total.
mandatory_axis_policy: If any mandatory axis is unavailable, suppress the total score.

experimental_axis_formula.rule: When at least one calibrated applicable V3 component exists, combine the official axis with the equal-weight V3 component mean. Otherwise suppress the dashed experimental axis rather than copying the official value.

official_total_score.input_axes: Published official axes only, computed from official_score_eligible metrics that passed V1/V2 gates.
official_total_score.gate: At least six axes, every mandatory role axis, at least three eligible matches, and every role-specific coverage gate must pass.
official_total_score.formula: For published role r axes A, official_total = sum(axis_weights_by_role[r][a] * official_axis[a] for a in A) / sum(axis_weights_by_role[r][a] for a in A).
official_total_score.missing_axis_rule: A missing mandatory axis suppresses the total. A missing declared optional axis is excluded, remaining weights are renormalized, and the omission is disclosed.
official_total_score.comparison_scope: Same nominal role, frozen TI 2026 corpus, and identical scoring version only.

experimental_total_score.official_total_prerequisite: official_total_score_v1 must be published for the same player, role, match set, and scoring version.
experimental_total_score.eligible_axis_set: Axes whose official value exists and whose dashed value contains at least one experimental_score_eligible V3 component that passed every V3 publication/calibration gate.
experimental_total_score.formula: Let E be the eligible experimental axis set. experimental_total = sum(axis_weights_by_role[r][a] * experimental_axis[a] for a in E) / sum(axis_weights_by_role[r][a] for a in E).
experimental_total_score.missing_axis_rule: Never copy an official axis into the dashed layer. Exclude a missing experimental axis, disclose it, and renormalize only across E. Suppress the experimental total unless |E| >= 3 and the sum of original role weights over E is >= 0.35.
experimental_total_score.v3_gate: Every included V3 component must satisfy the V3 evidence, minimum-20-reviewed-match, precision, recall, calibration, and abstention gates. Counterfactual components remain explicitly experimental.
experimental_total_score.display_rule: Show the included/suppressed axes, original and renormalized weights, V3 component percentiles, confidence, and exact recomputation. Never label this value as the official total.

axes.description: Lane execution, pressure, survival, and role-specific lane opportunity outcomes.
Farm/resource opportunities, item timing, and role-specific resource conversion.
Rotation, rune, smoke, response, and ability/item timing windows.
Observed side-lane, split-map, pressure, response, and cross-map exchange outcomes.
Ward/deward, visibility/contact, information, and smoke evidence under source gates.
Damage, control, healing/save events, initiation evidence, and survival by opportunity.
Tower, Roshan, Tormentor, barracks, high-ground, and post-fight conversion.
Death/buyback exposure, buyback rounds, decisive resets/re-entry, and terminal decisions.

display_requirements: Show raw metric values, percentiles, weights, opportunities, matches, coverage, confidence, and unavailable reasons.
Show official solid and experimental dashed radars separately.
Show official and experimental totals as differently named values.
Never render a cross-role combined leaderboard.
A score drilldown must reproduce the displayed value exactly.
